images.01: Small Uzbek barbershop interior: barber Bahodir, 50, thick black mustache, round belly, white barber coat, holding scissors and a comb; his daughter Sevara, 24, round glasses, ponytail, denim jacket, sitting with an open laptop beside the mirror. Mint green walls, retro barber chair, warm light.
images.02: Uzbek barber Bahodir, 50, thick black mustache, white barber coat, raising one finger proudly with a very confident grin, scissors in the other hand, barbershop mirror behind.
images.03: A young Uzbek man client sitting in a retro barber chair with a funny half-finished haircut, cape around his neck, laughing and pointing at himself, barbershop mirror.
images.04: Young Uzbek woman Sevara, 24, round glasses, ponytail, denim jacket, facepalming with one hand while holding a laptop, exasperated comic expression, barbershop background.
images.04_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but she now peeks through her fingers with one eye open, shaking her head.
images.05: Dark dramatic illustration: a giant padlock made of the digits 1 2 3 4 5 6 cracking and breaking apart, a shadowy hooded figure with a laptop behind it, red and dark blue palette.
images.06: Uzbek barber Bahodir, 50, mustache, white coat, scratching his head while thinking hard, eyes looking up, a calendar with his birthday circled on the wall behind him, barbershop.
images.07: Young Uzbek woman Sevara with round glasses and denim jacket teaching her father, pointing at a notebook page where three doodles are drawn: scissors, a teapot and a rain cloud; father with mustache listening attentively.
images.08: Uzbek barber Bahodir with mustache and white coat proudly writing on a big paper poster taped to the barbershop wall with a marker, very satisfied smile, daughter in background horrified.

hero: Bahodir aka (50, sartarosh, mo'ylov, oq xalat) + qizi Sevara (dasturchi, ko'zoynak) + mijoz
